questions.answer: Close the remaining SDD harness gaps: evidence correctness, stricter UI/data/TDD contracts, adapter replaceability, real SQLite validation proof, telemetry evidence completeness, and SOLID module boundaries.

Keep production database validation adapter-agnostic; use sql.js only in tests and fixtures; keep CLI commands stable; add optional .sdd/ui-inventory.json; keep compatibility flags as explicit waivers.
The prior close-harness-gaps feature is merged, but audit follow-up found missing adapter contract docs, stricter flow/TDD relations, real DB-copy proof, and dogfood evidence for remaining work.
No UI-facing experience; no experience.md required.
